services.name: Docent Program
services.desc: Volunteer docents are invaluable to the Isaacs Art Center; they play an important role in implementing the center's educational and community engagement missions. Professionals from all walks of life - doctors, lawyers, teachers, and artists, to name a few - are docents at the center. Prior knowledge of art is not required, only a passion to share and enjoy it with others! Isaacs Art Center's docents lend essential support to furthering the center's education and public outreach initiatives.
